refinedBaseNodes.label: ServiceRouter
refinedBaseNodes.refinement: Split into DelegationRoutePlanner plus durable TransportBindingStore; routing consumes an already-allowed PolicyDecision and never performs policy evaluation itself.

refinedBaseNodes.label: PolicyAdapter
refinedBaseNodes.refinement: Implemented as an external policy evaluation seam feeding durable PolicyDecision records. The adapter is not the decision store and transport security scopes are not application policy permissions.

deferredBaseNodes.label: A2AAdapter
deferredBaseNodes.clarification: R9 implements DeliveryAdapter seam and correlation semantics but does not claim a live remote A2A provider implementation.

deferredBaseNodes.label: MCPAdapter
deferredBaseNodes.clarification: R9 implements DeliveryAdapter seam and route binding semantics but does not claim a live delegated MCP provider implementation.

discoveredNodes.label: AgentInterfaceAdvertisementStore
discoveredNodes.reason: Revision-scoped endpoints/transports/security requirements are discovery and routing metadata distinct from capabilities and credentials.

discoveredNodes.label: PolicyDecisionStore
discoveredNodes.reason: A policy observation must become a durable exact decision before routing so replay does not silently re-evaluate changed policy.

discoveredNodes.label: PolicyEvaluationCoordinator
discoveredNodes.reason: Policy adapter invocation and exact request replay are a lifecycle separate from route planning.

discoveredNodes.label: DelegationRoutePlanner
discoveredNodes.reason: Routing selects only interfaces advertised by the target revision and only after an allowed decision bound to the same DelegationEnvelope.

discoveredNodes.label: TransportBindingStore
discoveredNodes.reason: Immutable route candidates must survive restart and support multiple primary/fallback bindings for one semantic delegation.

discoveredNodes.label: DeliveryReceiptStore
discoveredNodes.reason: Provider admission/status and remote task/context correlation are delivery facts distinct from local Task, Session and route binding truth.

discoveredNodes.label: DeliveryCoordinator
discoveredNodes.reason: One deterministic delivery request identity bridges an immutable TransportBinding to a replaceable transport adapter and replay-safe local receipt.

flow: future N20 A2AAdapter or N21 MCPAdapter concrete provider
authorityLaws: Capability advertisement does not bypass policy evaluation.
Interface security requirements describe authentication/authorization requirements; they contain no credentials or bearer tokens.
Application policy granted_permissions are not OAuth transport scopes.
A denied PolicyDecision cannot produce a TransportBinding.
PolicyDecision is bound to exactly one DelegationEnvelope and cannot authorize another envelope.
Exact policy request replay returns the historical decision before consulting current policy state.
One AgentRevision may advertise multiple endpoints for the same transport.
One DelegationEnvelope may have multiple immutable TransportBindings for primary/fallback routing.
TransportBinding contains local route truth and deterministic delivery request identity, never remote task/context correlation.
Remote A2A taskId/contextId are provider correlation values only and never replace local Task.id or Session.id.
DeliveryReceipt is the only R9 store for remote task/context correlation.
One DeliveryReceipt is durable per TransportBinding; exact delivery replay returns the committed local receipt without re-sending.

If provider commit succeeds but the response is lost before local receipt persistence, retry reuses the exact deterministic delivery_request_id; provider-level exact replay remains an adapter/provider contract, not a universal side-effect idempotency claim.

standardsBasis.use: Agent interfaces/security requirements are discovery metadata; remote Task IDs are service-assigned and context IDs are opaque remote correlation.
Transport authorization/security metadata remains distinct from semantic Session and application policy decisions.
